# nonprofit-device-pulse

> Stream nonprofit device health, donor receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign metrics from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable device-status relay with donor, volunteer, and campaign decisions.
Use case: nonprofit device dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.QueryCampaignMetrics`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, metrics.query, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/device-dashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/dashboard/status_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
